commit.title: upgpkg: 26.134.222-3: Add font helper script
commit.message:
upgpkg: 26.134.222-3: Add font helper script

The plymouth-font-file script is needed to get the actual font file from a
Pango font description. This ensures that the correct font is chosen
to be included in the initramfs and also simplifies the initramfs install
script. The previously used fc-match command does not handle complex font
descriptions with font variants correctly.
